etapes.fr: Type 3 = passé imaginaire : If + past perfect, would have + participe.
etapes.en: Third conditional: If + past perfect, would have + past participle. It talks about a past that did not happen.

exemples.en: If I had studied, I would have passed.
If we had left earlier, we wouldn't have missed the flight.
exemples.fr: Si nous étions partis plus tôt, nous n'aurions pas raté le vol.

etapes.fr: Conditionnel mixte : une condition passée avec un résultat présent.

exemples.en: If I had accepted that job, I would be rich now.
exemples.fr: Si j'avais accepté ce poste, je serais riche maintenant.

exemples.en: If she weren't so shy, she would have spoken.
exemples.fr: Si elle n'était pas si timide, elle aurait parlé.

lignes.en: Do you have any regrets about your studies?
lignes.fr: Tu as des regrets sur tes études ?

lignes.en: A few. If I had chosen computer science, I would have more job offers today.
lignes.fr: Quelques-uns. Si j'avais choisi l'informatique, j'aurais plus d'offres aujourd'hui.

lignes.en: In hindsight, maybe. But if you hadn't studied law, you wouldn't have met your best friends!
lignes.fr: Avec le recul, peut-être. Mais sans le droit, tu n'aurais pas rencontré tes meilleurs amis !

etapes.question: « If you ___ me, I would have helped. »
« If I had saved money, I ___ a car now. » (mixte)

etapes.en: I would have called if I had known

etapes.fr: Si j'avais su, je ne serais pas venu.
reponses: If I had known, I wouldn't have come.
If I had known, I would not have come.

etapes.en: If only I had listened to my mother!
choix: Si seulement j'avais écouté ma mère !

etapes.en: If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late.
etapes.fr: Si je n'avais pas raté le bus, je ne serais pas arrivé(e) en retard.

resume: Type 3: If + had + pp, would have + pp. Mixed: If + had + pp, would + verb (now).
devoir: Write about 3 decisions in your life and what would have happened otherwise.
